source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: My coding Agent says it fixed the bug but the tests still fail. It keeps declaring done prematurely. How do I fix this?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate proposer-reviewer-pattern, implement verification loop where test results (not Agent feeling) determine completion

test_cases.prompt: I need my Agent to generate high-quality reports. Right now it produces a first draft and stops. How do I improve quality?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate proposer-reviewer-pattern, implement Proposer-Reviewer iteration loop for report quality

test_cases.prompt: My Agent gives up after the first failed API call instead of trying alternative approaches. What pattern should I use?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate proposer-reviewer-pattern, the method prevents premature giving-up by having the reviewer check if alternatives exist

test_cases.prompt: How do I validate that my JSON API returns correct data?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate full proposer-reviewer; use simple deterministic validation (JSON schema check). This is a simple rule check.

test_cases.prompt: How do I constrain my Agent from executing dangerous operations?
My Agent generates art/creative content. A reviewer Agent keeps rejecting it for subjective reasons. What should I do?
test_cases.expected_behavior: The reviewer aesthetic may differ from the user. Incorporate user preference feedback into the review criteria. The book notes this risk: the Reviewer may converge on a wrong local optimum without user input.
